items.html: And for this reason (28) the first three kings did not die, since they have a great illumination and their vessel is very exalted, being made from the discernment of the upper Ozen and from the Hotem and the Peh. For by the look of the eye at the lights of Ozen, Hotem, and Peh (29) their vessels were made, as above; for they took their vessels from a place where the lights of the Ozen, which are the discernment of Neshama, are still extended, namely down to the Shibolet of the beard, as above. However, the seven lower kings died, because their vessels were made from the look of the eye at the Hotem and the Peh alone, and the light of the upper Ozen was missing from them.
